UGA.note: The piece reports a procurement of a filtering tool, not a rule or a designated authority over AI harms.

facts.fact: Minister Kasule Lumumba said the Uganda Communications Commission is in the process of procuring an AI-powered system to identify and filter harmful content; cost, vendor and date were not disclosed.
facts.system: UCC AI content filtering system (being procured)

UGA.note: The tool is for content regulation, not a health, education, agriculture, tax or similar sector system.
